title: Article 360 — Provisions as to financial emergency

content.heading: Provisions as to financial emergency
content.text: If the President is satisfied that a situation has arisen whereby the financial stability or credit of India or of any part of the territory thereof is threatened, he may by a Proclamation make a declaration to that effect. While such a Proclamation is in operation, the Union may give directions to States on financial propriety and may require reduction of salaries and reservation of Money Bills as enacted.
